pairs.subject: plan-entitlements
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:31 The gate collapses the entitlement check to a boolean (byomUnlocked) and coerces missing tenant records to the free tier (getUserPlan) instead of returning an enumerated decision or treating an unknown tenant as a distinct refusal.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:31 The entitlement gate returns a boolean rather than an enumerated decision (unlimited, allowance, credit, denied), and getUserPlan converts missing Firestore tenant records to 'free' rather than refusing unknown tenants.
src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:28 In self-hosted mode (SELF_HOSTED=true), byomUnlocked short-circuits the BYOM entitlement to true via devByomUnlockActive while preserving user authentication.

src/app/api/byom/keys/route.ts:56 User configuration survives plan downgrades as dormant read-only data, and DELETE permits cleaning up stored provider keys without requiring an active BYOM entitlement.
src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:35 The machine identifier 'byom' is used for store reads and internal entitlement checks, while localized user-facing copy and upgrade links remain decoupled.
src/app/api/byom/route.ts:14 BYOM settings routes do not support custom enterprise negotiated contracts or bespoke price agreements.
src/app/api/byom/matrix/route.ts:6 Tiers and operation definitions are code-resident in TypeScript modules rather than an operator-editable live store.
src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:36 The route guard points to /cena for upgrades but does not render prices or derive billing amounts.
src/app/api/byom/route.ts:15 The endpoint serves internal application clients rather than publishing operator-defined limit vocabularies to external consumers.
src/app/api/byom/matrix/route.ts:4 Operation overrides in the BYOM matrix configure routing per user, not subtractive capability removals against an inherited plan tier.
src/app/api/byom/guard.ts:12 Route guards import their entitlement check from the central usage and plans model rather than duplicating tier logic.

declined.subject: plan-entitlements
declined.reason: The context covers public marketing showcase pages with seeded sample data for unauthenticated visitors. The 'plan' terminology in SeededPlanTable and VisibilityPlanBand refers to organic marketing channel plans (content/SEO strategy), not subscription plan entitlements. With no billing tiers, capability gates, or subscription lifecycle handling in this context and 'not-applicable' prohibited from this seat, this pair is declined.
